WECHASER/ABOUT

A one-person × AI
enterprise AI company.

WeChaser is not a 50-person startup. It's a working model under active validation — using Claude, Hermes, and Shiguangmailuo as force-multipliers, scaling one person's output to industrial-grade client work.

01 / Manifesto

We don't compete with AI tools.
We make them more useful.

The largest waste of 2026: every company is building its own ChatGPT wrapper, but nobody is solving "AI doesn't actually understand this company".

The market has enough AI tools. Claude, ChatGPT, Lark AI, DingTalk AI — none lack a brain. What they lack is real understanding of this specific company. One engineer's 23 years of judgment matter more than a million industrial examples in GPT-5's training data.

We're not selling another chatbox. We're building middleware for the enterprise AI ecosystem — the "understands this company" layer that every AI tool calls. It's a narrow problem. It's an unsexy problem. But it's the most important missing piece in 2026.

02 / Business model (public)

Trojan horse.
Consulting is the door, knowledge base is the product.

We publish the whole model — there's nothing to "sales-trick" a client into.
A · Entry

High-margin consulting

Structured methodology + industry case library + AI co-pilots, delivered hands-on. Deliverables: workflow audit, AI transformation roadmap, problem diagnosis, smallest-viable pilot design. This is the paid layer.

B · Retention

Free knowledge base

Everything produced during consulting (recordings / notes / client docs / AI reports) → distilled into Shiguangmailuo → after a few months of usage the client can't go back.

C · Expansion

Client comes back

Find a specific wedge ("now wire in sales") → priced feature development. This is the scale layer — but only fires after A + B have proved out.

Why publish? The model's strength isn't secrecy — it's the absence of conflict. Consulting really does deliver concrete artifacts; the KB really is a gift; the upsell happens only when the client comes back. No room for information-asymmetry sleight of hand.

03 / Working values

Six non-negotiables.

01 / FOCUS

Run first, iterate after

Don't be paralysed by polished UI. Install, operate, run. Everything else waits for real usage.

02 / TRUTH

100% citation

We're heading toward industrial production decisions. Zero tolerance for hallucination. If we don't know, we say so.

03 / DEPTH

3-5 deep, never broad

At most 3-5 clients in flight. Depth over breadth — one client done thoroughly beats ten half-finished.

04 / OPEN

Tech + business model in public

Architecture, stack, business model, client cases — all public. We don't profit from information asymmetry.

05 / LOCAL

Data stays inside

Knowledge base, vector store and file originals all live on the client's own servers. Generation runs either on open-weight models on local GPUs (air-gappable) or on a compliant API the client approves. Sensitive data never leaves the client network — non-negotiable.

06 / AI-NATIVE

One-person × AI

Shawn + AI co-workers (Claude / Hermes / Shiguangmailuo). AI as colleague, not tooling.

04 / Delivery guarantees

Small team.
The system doesn't depend on us.

"One-person company" is the risk procurement asks about first. Our answer: build the system so it keeps running even if we part ways.
A / OWNERSHIP

Runs on your servers

Knowledge base, vectors and originals live in your data center, started with one docker-compose command. Data and runtime are always yours.

B / HANDOVER

On-site until you own it

During rollout an engineer stays on-site until your IT team can operate it and add data sources on their own.

C / FOCUS

3–5 clients at a time

No mass sales. The founder personally owns every engagement from discovery to go-live.

D / RISK

Free discovery, milestone billing

Phase one is free; each later phase is paid on acceptance, and you can stop at any milestone.
